primarySourceInputs.appliedPattern: Track Security-Policy, Dependency-Update-Tool, Pinned-Dependencies, Token-Permissions, Dangerous-Workflow, SAST, Signed-Releases, Packaging, and CI posture as explicit evidence.
Separate local provenance configuration from real provenance existence, authenticity, isolation, and attestation verification.

Pin actions to full-length commit SHAs, minimize GITHUB_TOKEN permissions, configure Dependabot update ecosystems, configure CodeQL advanced setup, and use artifact/provenance boundaries without claiming hosted execution locally.
Treat npm provenance as a verifiable link to source/build instructions, not as proof that the package is safe or release-ready.

classifiedUnresolvedGaps.reason: A real Scorecard run requires external repository/API access or a container/tool invocation, so this local gate records posture evidence only.
Hosted CI evidence requires a real GitHub repository/remote workflow run; this workspace is not currently a Git repository root.
The local CodeQL workflow file is configured, but hosted CodeQL analysis evidence requires a GitHub Actions run on a real GitHub repository boundary.
Signed attestation verification requires a real release artifact and external registry/provenance boundary.
